segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Thanks for making time. Before anything else - what is driving the interest right now?

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: Our onboarding takes 6 weeks today, and the reporting behind it is all manual. Every new hire adds two weeks of setup.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: How does the onboarding path look today, and where does the reporting cost you time?

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: The reporting is a full day per week, and onboarding needs three approvals. It is the biggest pain, honestly.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: If we cut both to same-day, what would that be worth?

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: At least 20 percent of team capacity, around 40 hours a month.

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: Our CFO will need to sign anything above the threshold, so it goes through her for budget.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: What would you evaluate us against if we ran a pilot?

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: Main criteria are rollout speed and the audit trail; we would compare against the current process before any commitment.

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: The process would be procurement review then signature by the end of October.

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: I will champion this internally and set up the steering committee, happy to drive it.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Then let's book the technical session next week - does Thursday work?

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: Thursday works. Looking forward to it.
